dashboardQueries.query:
$conn.metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
$conn.metadata.product_event_type = "conn"
$conn.observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
$conn.about.namespace in %corelight_ai_apps
$conn.network.session_id = $uid

$anomaly.metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
$anomaly.metadata.product_event_type = "anomaly"
$anomaly.observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
$anomaly.network.session_id = $uid
$score = cast.as_int(cast.as_float($anomaly.security_result.detection_fields["item_score"])*100)
match:
    $uid
outcome:
    $app = array_distinct($conn.about.namespace)
    $total_bytes_kb = array_distinct(math.round(($conn.network.sent_bytes + $conn.network.received_bytes)/1024, 2))
    $item_score = max($score/100)
    $use_case_description = array_distinct($anomaly.security_result.description)
    $orig_h = array_distinct($conn.principal.ip)
    $event_time = array_distinct(timestamp.get_timestamp($conn.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds))
    $time = max($conn.metadata.event_timestamp.seconds)
order:
    $time, $item_score asc
limit:
    10000

metadata.vendor_name = "Corelight"
metadata.product_event_type = "conn"
observer.hostname = /$sensor$/ nocase
about.namespace in %corelight_ai_apps
$risk_tier = if(re.regex(about.namespace, `^(moonshot|zhipu-ai|alibaba-qwen|baidu-ernie|bytedance-doubao|minimax|01ai-yi|sensetime|iflytek-spark|baichuan-ai|stepfun|openrouter|litellm|braintrust|portkey|helicone)$`), "High", if(re.regex(about.namespace, `^(github-copilot|codeium|tabnine|sourcegraph-cody|amazon-q|crewai|zapier-ai|mistral|cohere|deepseek|groq|together-ai|fireworks-ai|replicate|ai21|inflection-pi|lepton-ai|octoai|meta-ai|deepl|forefront-ai|adept-ai|chatgpt|google-gemini|claude|anthropic|openai|midjourney|stability-ai|runwayml|elevenlabs|pika|synthesia|suno|udio|langsmith|pinecone|chroma|wandb|baseten|modal|weaviate)$`), "Medium", if(re.regex(about.namespace, `^(otter-ai|fireflies-ai|notion-ai|krisp|tldv|fathom|read-ai|mem-ai|microsoft-copilot|you-ai|phind|character-ai|kagi|nvidia-ngc|gpt4all|scale-ai|datarobot|adobe-firefly|poe|leonardo-ai|lakera|arthur-ai)$`), "Low", "Unknown")))
$risk_tier = /$risk$/ nocase
$time_bucket = timestamp.get_timestamp(metadata.event_timestamp.seconds, "%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00", "UTC")
$app = about.namespace
match:
    $time_bucket, $app
outcome:
    $count = count(network.session_id)
order:
    $time_bucket, $count asc
